question: When were the two annual plans carried out?
solution:
The correct answer is __**After the seventh Five-Year Plan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The two annual plans were carried out from **1990-1992**.
 
• These plans were implemented **after the completion of the Seventh Five-Year Plan (1985-1990)**.
 
• The annual plans were introduced due to the **political and economic instability** in the country at that time.
 
• The Eighth Five-Year Plan could not start in 1990 due to **economic crisis and political uncertainties**.
 
• These annual plans focused on **immediate needs** and **short-term goals** rather than long-term planning.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Seventh Five-Year Plan (1985-1990)**

 
 
• The Seventh Plan aimed at accelerating food production, increasing employment opportunities, and improving productivity.
 
• It focused on establishing a self-sufficient economy with robust infrastructure.
 
• The plan emphasized policies for poverty alleviation and technological advancement.
 
• It achieved significant growth in the agricultural and service sectors.
 
 
 
• **Economic Crisis of 1991**
 
 
• India faced a severe balance of payments crisis in 1991, leading to the introduction of economic reforms.
 
• The crisis necessitated immediate policy measures to stabilize the economy.
 
• The reforms included liberalization, privatization, and globalization (LPG) policies.
 
• These measures helped to open up the Indian economy to global markets.
 
 
 
• **Eighth Five-Year Plan (1992-1997)**
 
 
• Formulated after the 1991 economic reforms, focusing on human resource development and industrial growth.
 
• It aimed to achieve high growth rates and reduce poverty.
 
• The plan emphasized the modernization of industries and infrastructure development.
 
• It marked a shift from centralized planning to a more market-oriented approach.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Annual Plans**
 
 
• Annual plans are short-term plans formulated for one year.
 
• They are used during periods of transition between two Five-Year Plans.
 
• These plans focus on immediate needs and short-term objectives.
 
• They provide flexibility to address unforeseen economic challenges and political instability.
